description: Municipio de Chitré publishes a list of the hospitals and health centres in the district of Chitré, Herrera province, with their location and telephone numbers, published in CSV, XLS and PDF. Coverage: the district of Chitré, Panama; the portal record was last modified on 2022-07-04. Format and access: PDF, XLS, CSV, downloadable without registration from the Panama national open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: a small municipal list without coordinates, capacity or service data; the files were not opened, so the number of facilities and the columns are unconfirmed; a similar list exists for the Tonosí district. Simulation uses: local facility layers for healthcare accessibility and emergency-response models, and a check of national health-facility registers at district scale. Related catalogue records: Panama national open data catalogue (data-panama-national-open-data-catalogue); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
